title: 'Abasa 80:17-24 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 16 (Pupil PDF worksheet: 'Abasa 80:17-24 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 16. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ (١٧) مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ (١٨) مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ (١٩) ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ (٢٠) ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ (٢١) ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ (٢٢) كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ (٢٣) فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ (٢٤)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.
From what substance did He create him?
From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
Then He eased the way for him;
Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
Then let mankind look at his food -

keywords.def: a drop: the beginning of a person

questions.q: Chunk and link 'Abasa 80:17-24 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 80:17-24 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 80:17-24 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: In the portal box, write the stages of life named in 80:18 to 22.
questions.a: Created from a drop, proportioned, the way made easy, death, burial, then raised again.

questions.q: Explain how 80:17 to 23 lead to the command in 80:24.
questions.a: After showing man's creation and dependence, Allah points to food as a daily reminder of His care.
A) his food. 'Then let mankind look at his food' (80:24); the next ayat describe how Allah grows it.

questions.q: Think again: From a tiny drop to a full life, Allah eased the way. Then 80:24 says: 'let man look at his food'. What could you learn from looking at your dinner tonight?
questions.a: Every food is a gift and a sign: Allah sends rain, splits the earth and grows it (80:24 to 32).
